# mux_environment (Data Source)

The Mux environment the provider's access token belongs to, and what the token may do. Useful as a guard: a `check` or `precondition` on `type` or `name` keeps a configuration from being applied to the wrong environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mux_environment" "this" {}

output "mux_environment" {
  value = "${data.mux_environment.this.organization_name} / ${data.mux_environment.this.name} (${data.mux_environment.this.type})"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `access_token_name` (String) Name of the access token in use.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization the environment is in.
- `organization_name` (String) Name of the organization.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions of the access token, e.g. `video:read`, `video:write`, `system:write`.
- `type` (String) Environment type, e.g. `production` or `development`.
